# Abdul Jaleel Kavungal — studio portfolio

> Studio portfolio of open work in trustworthy AI, agent systems, and secure software.

## Selected work

- [Aletheia](https://abduljaleel.xyz/aletheia/): Infrastructure for autonomous agents.
- [ax](https://abduljaleel.xyz/ax/): A fast, provider-agnostic AI coding agent — built without the trade-offs.
- [EvolveHandsAI](https://abduljaleel.xyz/EvolveHandsAI/): The self-evolving code engine.
- [VIM](https://abduljaleel.xyz/vim/): Vulnerability Inheritance Map.
- [Wharf](https://abduljaleel.xyz/wharf/): A dock for your Managed Agents.
- [X-Road](https://abduljaleel.xyz/X-Road/): Secure data exchange, instrumented.
- [LoopbackCloud](https://abduljaleel.xyz/loopbackcloud/): Local cloud emulator for AI agents (also hosted on this hub).
